overview: The School Committee reviewed technical updates to the Chapter 74 vocational admissions policy, discussed operational and religious holiday constraints regarding the 2026-2027 school calendar, and walked through proposed revisions to the committee's operating rules. The committee approved the consent agenda, adopted the revised vocational admissions policy, and directed that consolidated rules be presented at the next meeting.

items.title: Consent agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills and payrolls, meeting minutes, and a $1,000 PTO donation.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Science Fair recognition
items.summary: Science Director Rocco Cieri and Superintendent Galusi introduced Medford High School Science Fair awardees, who presented overviews of their research projects.

items.title: Chapter 74 CTE admissions policy update
items.summary: Approved language revisions required by the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education to clarify details and retention pathways in the vocational admissions lottery policy.

items.title: 2026-2027 school year calendar review
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi outlined scheduling constraints for the 2026-2027 school year caused by a late Labor Day, five required snow days, and staffing impacts on Good Friday, noting upcoming community and union discussions ahead of a revised proposal.

items.title: School Committee term objectives
items.summary: Tabled review of the summary of objectives from the January retreat.

items.title: School Committee rules revisions
items.summary: Voted to direct Member Ruseau to consolidate proposed edits to the committee's operating rules, covering summer meetings, materials deadlines, and charter alignment, for final action at the next meeting.
